mapping.note: Never scaled; smoothing only touches norm outputs and their readers.
Phi3RMSNorm upcasts to fp32 and multiplies by its weight: a pure per-channel scale, so dividing by s is exact. The repo's assert and dispatch reject the class (D1). model.norm is untouched.
q, k and v are one fused linear [9216, 3072] (32 q + 32 kv heads x 96). It is the only reader of input_layernorm, so s goes into this one weight (D2).
gate and up are one fused linear [16384, 3072] (first half gate, second half up). It is the only reader of post_attention_layernorm (D3).
Not smoothed, as in the repo. Its input carries the model's largest activation outliers (D8).
Phi-3 has no linear biases (attention_bias=false, all four linears bias=false).
Untied (tie_word_embeddings=false); both untouched and kept fp16, lm_head stored separately (D10).

mapping.role: KV cache and attention BMM inputs
mapping.note: Kept fp16. The repo's published PPLs fake-quantize q/k/v outputs (quantize_bmm_input=True); this port does not (D11).

differences.detail: The repo's family glue does not know Phi-3. smooth_lm has an isinstance switch with no else branch, so Phi3DecoderLayer is skipped silently (the model stays unsmoothed and only quality shows it); smooth_ln_fcs_llama_like asserts the norm is Llama/Mistral/Mixtral RMSNorm; quantize_model raises ValueError for Phi3PreTrainedModel; quantize_llama_like looks for LlamaAttention/LlamaMLP and q_proj/k_proj/v_proj/gate_proj/up_proj attributes, none of which exist on Phi3Attention/Phi3MLP. get_act_scales is generic (hooks every nn.Linear by name) and works unchanged. Add a Phi-3 branch to smooth_lm (two sites per layer), accept Phi3RMSNorm in the smoothing assert, and add a Phi-3 quantize path that turns qkv_proj, o_proj, gate_up_proj and down_proj into W8A8 linears. The wrapper must fail if any layer's norms are unchanged after smoothing.

Phi-3 fuses q/k/v into self_attn.qkv_proj, the single reader of input_layernorm. The Llama glue's reader list [q_proj, k_proj, v_proj] and its act-scale key name + '.self_attn.q_proj' do not exist here. Per method.md Invariants the fused weight is the one reader: s = act_scales['<layer>.self_attn.qkv_proj']^a / colmax(qkv_proj.weight)^(1-a), divide input_layernorm.weight by s, multiply all 3072 qkv_proj columns by s. The column max over the fused rows equals the repo's max over separate q/k/v, and per-row int8 scales on the fused weight equal per-part scales, so the result is numerically the repo's algorithm. Smoothing only part of the fused weight, or using another linear's act scales, would change the function.

Phi-3 fuses gate and up into mlp.gate_up_proj [16384, 3072], the single reader of post_attention_layernorm. The repo uses [gate_proj, up_proj] with the act-scale key '.mlp.gate_proj'. Smooth post_attention_layernorm into gate_up_proj with act_scales['<layer>.mlp.gate_up_proj']. Phi3MLP splits the output with chunk(2) after the matmul, so the row layout is untouched.

The repo's Llama-family path only holds a fake-quant model in memory (W8A8Linear stores dequantized fp16 weights); its real-int8 save is OPT-only and needs torch_int. Save the w8a8_int8 format unchanged from the published recipe so export_vllm.py (profile w8a8_int8) and the shared w8a8_int8_triton kernel match it: int8 '<linear>.weight' [N,K], fp16 '<linear>.weight_scale' [N,1], smoothed fp16 norms, fp16 embed_tokens / model.norm / lm_head (untied, so lm_head.weight is stored), and quantization_config.json with format w8a8_int8, w_bits 8, a_bits 8, weight_quant per_channel, act_quant per_token, w_sym/a_sym true. Ship an inference adapter that rebuilds the 128 W8A8 linears from int8 + scale and runs the shared Triton int8 GEMM, with SDPA attention.

config.json carries auto_map (configuration_phi3 / modeling_phi3), so the pipeline passes trust_remote_code=True to the inference adapter and the smoke reference (wants_remote_code). transformers 4.46.3 has Phi3ForCausalLM natively, and the saved artifact has no configuration_phi3.py, so AutoConfig.from_pretrained(artifact, trust_remote_code=True) would fail if auto_map were kept. Load the model natively (Phi3ForCausalLM, never remote code) in the wrapper, strip auto_map from the saved config.json, and load natively in the adapter regardless of the trust_remote_code argument.

The checkpoint is bf16. The repo calibrates in fp16 (generate_act_scales.py:15) but reports PPL on bf16 (ppl_eval.py:69-71); the smoke reference, verify, benchmark and the w8a8_int8 format (fp16 weight_scale) are fp16. Evidence that fp16 holds Phi-3.5's activations: a CPU fp32 forward of 1024 tokens (model card text) gave max |residual| 3984, max |down_proj input| 971 and max |down_proj output| 3082, about 16x below the fp16 limit of 65504; Phi3RMSNorm computes its variance in fp32. Calibrate, smooth and quantize in fp16 like the recipe; the wrapper asserts finite act scales and finite logits, and the saved config sets torch_dtype float16.

Migration strength. The recipe used the Llama-2 value 0.85; the paper picks alpha per model by grid search. Evidence for Phi-3.5 from the same CPU probe (fp32, 1024 tokens of model-card text, in-sample act maxima, 11 of 32 layers, per-token int8 activations x per-channel int8 weights, relative output error of each smoothed linear): qkv_proj a=0 (no smoothing) 0.0232, 0.5 0.0135, 0.65 0.0111, 0.75 0.0119, 0.8 0.0129, 0.85 0.0144, 0.9 0.0164; gate_up_proj 0 0.0159, 0.5 0.0148, 0.65 0.0127, 0.75 0.0127, 0.8 0.0134, 0.85 0.0143. The minimum is flat over 0.65-0.75 and 0.85 is 20% (qkv) / 13% (gate_up) worse. Use alpha 0.75: inside the minimum, and the upper end because the probe's text is not Pile and its maxima are in-sample (out-of-sample outliers favour a larger alpha). Not a Pile grid search on perplexity; the smoothed-linear error is also 3-4x smaller than the unsmoothed down_proj error (D8), so alpha is second-order for PPL.

Phi-3.5's down_proj input (act(gate) * up) has massive per-channel outliers: max |x| up to 971 and per-channel max/median up to 4531 (layer 2) in the probe, and its per-token W8A8 output error is 0.054 mean / 0.071 max versus 0.012-0.014 for the smoothed linears and 0.022 for o_proj. The repo never smooths down_proj. A function-preserving extension exists (method.md Invariants): divide the up half of gate_up_proj (rows 8192-16383) by s and multiply down_proj's columns by s. NOT done in this plan, which stays on the repo's two smoothing sites; it is the first thing to try if WikiText-2 shows a quality gap.
evidence: paper section 4 (fuse s into previous layers)

differences.detail: longrope rope_scaling and sliding_window=262144 live inside attention and are not touched by smoothing or by quantizing the linears. Calibration at 512 tokens and the smoke at 256 use the short factors (seq <= original_max_position_embeddings 4096), exactly as fp16 inference does; the adapter keeps the native rotary module.
Embeddings are not tied (tie_word_embeddings=false). SmoothQuant leaves both in fp16; the int8 export keeps lm_head.weight as its own fp16 tensor and the vLLM export lists lm_head in ignore.

differences.role: KV cache and attention BMM inputs
differences.detail: quantize_model defaults to quantize_bmm_input=False but the repo's reported Llama/Mistral PPLs use True (q/k/v outputs fake-quantized per token). The w8a8_int8 format, the shared kernel and vLLM's int-quantized scheme have no q/k/v output quantization, so this port keeps attention inputs and the KV cache fp16 (False). This can only lower the error compared with the repo's reported setting.
No linear in Phi-3 has a bias, so the bias role is empty; the export and adapter simply store none.

notes: Positive method recipe: SmoothQuant x Qwen2.5-1.5B on vast-rtx3090 (same repo commit, PPL ratio 1.015, w8a8_int8 + Triton int8 GEMM adapter, vLLM export passed). Reused: the role mapping, int8 export, the w8a8_int8 saved format and the adapter structure; not its module names. One plan (phi3_fused_path) because the recipe is positive and the spec has one obvious path: extend the repo's own pipeline with a Phi-3 branch. D8 (smoothing down_proj through the up rows) is held back as the fallback, not a second plan, because it goes beyond the repo's scheme. Smoke gate kept at defaults: all 4 decoder linears x 2 layers are W8A8, no layer is kept in fp16.
